seedRule.formula: seedOf(family, [i]) = reduce(H32(family + '/' + i)); H32 = MurmurHash3 x86_128 h1, seed 0, of the UTF-8 label (V12 section 2.4)
seedRule.parkMiller: 1 + (H32 mod 2147483646), the MINSTD state range 1 .. 2147483646 (ARCHITECTURE section 13.6 (2))
seedRule.collisionDomain: capture families are excluded from the collision domain (they seed a reference, not us; V12 section 2.4), so no capture path ever gains /r1
seedRule.checkVectorNote: capture/MFCG/80/river+coast/9 checks the formula at an index beyond the plan's five stress seeds (i = 0..4); it is no plan entry

MFCG.rule: re-resolved by profiler/lib/common.mjs resolveTargetUrl at capture time; a newer build is a declared pin shift and the owner is told before the sweep (M-1-plan sections 5, 9)

FTG.build: ftg:<server date>+<sha256 of the create-request body, 12 hex>, per capture

mfcgExport.tool: research/baselines/mfcg_sweep_m1.mjs (W-03, J159); research/baselines/mfcg_j161_m1.mjs (J161: m1/W-03-complete and W-03b); both modelled on profiler/export.mjs
mfcgExport.perSeed: one load per seed (R-16): the JSON by the URL export key on load (the entry's exports[0]), the SVG by the app's own export window in the same page (E03); exports[1], the SVG key of the 2026-09-25 sweep's one-load-per-file method, is kept for reference and never loaded
mfcgExport.loads: J159: 35, one per declared seed (W-03); J161: 3 -- seed 0's cold re-export and the retry of capture/MFCG/130/plain/8 (m1/W-03-complete) and R-13's extension to index 10 (W-03b); any further load is a new owner's approval (M-1-plan section 5)
mfcgExport.retryRule: an export whose console trace shows a second attempt (a different internal seed under the same href) is recorded in the row's sample.failed with reason retry, never dropped (C7)
mfcgExport.extendRule: R-13 (M-1-rulings-1.md): a formula family whose usable count falls below its declared n extends by the next formula index until n usable -- never a hand-chosen seed; the failed index stays in the row's sample.failed; every added index is a load under an owner's approval; set by plan.py --extend and kept by every regeneration

ngRecord.perSeed: one cold load per seed, no regeneration, so every generation is the plan's seed

extension.rule: R-13 (M-1-rulings-1.md): a formula family whose usable count falls below its declared n extends by the next formula index until n usable -- never a hand-chosen seed; the failed index stays in the row's sample.failed; every added index is a load under an owner's approval; set by plan.py --extend and kept by every regeneration
extension.note: index 8 froze twice (no-export, 2 loads: W-03 and m1/W-03-complete's retry); index 10 is J161's third load, W-03b (R-13, R-39)

ftg.why: the server draws its own seed; the plan lists capture slots in capture order (V12 section 3.2.1)
ftg.slotRule: slot k is the k-th capture taken, slots filled in slot order (bind refuses a slot while an earlier one is open); a slot never taken is recorded failed with its reason, never faked (M-1-plan section 9; ARCHITECTURE 13.6 (12)); the list is the concatenation of the two declared programmes below, and an extension can only append (R-36: the first six labels and the uniqueness of every label are checked before any write); a recorded slot (bound or failed) keeps its label, size, water, programme and day against the prior plan.json and is never removed, so a schedule edit cannot relabel, re-date, move or drop a capture (m1/plan-fix-3, m1/plan-guard-2); rows after the last recorded slot may be struck or reordered (the owner's veto of R-33)

programmes.rulings: J159 (slot 0, guest, one per day); J163 (slots 1-5, the owner's signed-in account, one sitting)
J164 (one premium month; M-1-rulings-2.md R-33 .. R-36)
programmes.order: by slot number: METROPOLIS first, then BIG_TOWN and BIG_CITY alternating, then CITY and TOWN
programmes.procedure: research/baselines/ftg_capture_checklist.md section I (programme 2's procedure, written by m1/plan-fix-3 from M-1-plan section 2.1b: section H with the premium differences)

ftg.recordedRule: as recorded (R-02; the Fantasy Manor sample is the precedent, V12 section 3.2.1): the two CITY captures made before the plan hold the family's first two indices; the 2026-09-25 one is a declared non-default setting, kept in sample.failed with reason setting and pooled in no row (R-04); the planned CITY slots continue the per-water index and the family order after them, so with slots 24 and 25 the family reaches three usable, minmax (R-33, R-34)
ftg.populationSource: nominal unless the decoded payload holds a resident count (re-checked per capture); the account list's per-settlement population is recorded beside it, never used (R-37)
